output.summary: A cultivated banana hybrid between Musa acuminata and Musa balbisiana, domesticated very early by humans. Its apparent trunk consists of fused leaf bases; each produces one flowering stem, dies after fruiting and may be replaced by shoots from the base.
output.edibilityNote: Its cultivars include cooking and dessert bananas; the described banana-da-terra fruit is mainly cooked, fried or baked.
